quests.instruction: Your parents are not upset after you tell them the truth about a mistake. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Sharing something you were nervous about and hearing it is okay can make your chest feel lighter.
quests.explanation: Sharing something you were nervous about and hearing it is okay makes your chest feel lighter.
quests.funFact: Telling the truth, even when it is hard, almost always feels better once it is finally said!

quests.instruction: You watch fireworks explode into giant, colorful shapes. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Watching huge bursts of color light up the sky can leave you staring in wonder.
quests.explanation: Watching huge bursts of color light up the sky can leave you with a wide-eyed, astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: Different chemicals inside fireworks create each of their different, dazzling colors!

quests.instruction: You help a younger student who is struggling with their shoelaces. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Helping someone smaller who is having trouble with a task feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Helping someone smaller who is having trouble with a task gives you a warm, kind feeling.
quests.funFact: Being a helpful role model for younger kids is a big responsibility that many older kids enjoy!

quests.instruction: You keep practicing your cartwheel even after falling many times. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Deciding not to give up, no matter how many tries it takes, feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Deciding not to give up, no matter how many tries it takes, gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: Most gymnasts fall hundreds of times before mastering a new move — every fall is practice!

quests.instruction: You keep checking the oven every minute waiting for the cookies to bake. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Checking again and again for something to finish can make the wait feel very restless.
quests.explanation: Checking again and again for something to finish can give you a restless, waiting feeling.
quests.funFact: Opening the oven too often can actually make cookies take even longer to bake!

quests.instruction: Your mom's flight lands safely after a stormy night. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Hearing that someone you were worried about is safe can make your chest feel lighter.
quests.explanation: Hearing that someone you were worried about is safe makes your whole body feel lighter.
quests.funFact: A big exhale is a very common, natural way your body releases this lighter feeling!

quests.instruction: You see a shooting star streak brightly across the night sky. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Catching a sudden flash of light across the whole sky can leave you staring in wonder.
quests.explanation: Catching a sudden, bright flash across the whole sky can leave you with an astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: Shooting stars are actually small bits of space dust burning up as they enter our atmosphere!

quests.instruction: You save a piece of your lunch for a friend who forgot theirs. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Giving up a small part of your own lunch to help a friend feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Giving up a small part of your own lunch to help a friend gives you a warm, kind feeling.
quests.funFact: Sharing food is one of the oldest and most common ways people show kindness to each other!

quests.instruction: You practice free throws every single day until you make ten in a row. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Sticking to a daily goal until you master it feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Sticking to a daily goal until you master it gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: Many great athletes say daily practice, not natural talent alone, is the real secret to success!

quests.instruction: You keep checking your seedling every hour, wishing it would grow faster. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Wanting slow, natural growth to speed up can feel restless and eager.
quests.explanation: Wanting slow, natural growth to speed up can give you a restless, eager feeling.
quests.funFact: Plants grow at their own steady pace — checking daily photos can help you see the slow progress!

quests.instruction: You find your missing homework in your backpack after searching everywhere. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Finding something important you thought was lost can make your worry melt away.
quests.explanation: Finding something important you thought was lost makes your worry melt away and your body feel lighter.
quests.funFact: Checking the same spot twice sometimes works — sometimes we miss things the first time!

quests.instruction: You see a whale leap almost completely out of the ocean. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Watching a massive animal do something unexpected can leave you completely still with wonder.
quests.explanation: Watching a massive animal do something unexpected can leave you with a wide-eyed, astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: This leaping move is called breaching, and scientists think whales may do it just for fun!

quests.instruction: You check on your neighbor's cat while they are away. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Taking responsibility to look after someone else's pet feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Taking responsibility to look after someone else's pet gives you a warm, kind feeling.
quests.funFact: Pet-sitting is a great way to show responsibility while helping out a neighbor!

quests.instruction: You decide to practice your speech one more time, even though it is already late. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Choosing to put in extra effort toward something important feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Choosing to put in extra effort toward something important gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: One more practice run can make a real difference in how ready and steady you feel!

quests.instruction: You keep shaking the wrapped present, wishing you could open it right now. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Wanting to skip ahead to a fun moment can make you fidget with excitement.
quests.explanation: Wanting to skip ahead to a fun moment can give you a restless, waiting feeling.
quests.funFact: The waiting itself is part of what makes opening a gift feel extra special!

quests.instruction: Your team finds the missing trophy right before the ceremony. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Finding something important just in time can make a wave of worry disappear.
quests.explanation: Finding something important just in time makes a wave of worry disappear and your body feel lighter.
quests.funFact: Keeping a special spot for important items can help prevent this kind of last-minute search!

quests.instruction: You watch a magician pull a rabbit out of an empty hat. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Watching something that seems almost impossible can leave your mouth wide open.
quests.explanation: Watching something that seems almost impossible can leave you with a wide-eyed, astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: Magicians spend years practicing quick, hidden movements to create tricks that leave us astonished!

quests.instruction: You notice a classmate sitting alone and invite them to join your group. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Noticing someone who might need a friend and reaching out feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Noticing someone who might need a friend and reaching out gives you a warm, kind feeling.
quests.funFact: A simple invitation like this can turn into a whole new friendship!

quests.instruction: You practice your handwriting every night until it looks just right. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Sticking with a small daily habit to improve a skill feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Sticking with a small daily habit to improve a skill gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: Handwriting, like any skill, gets smoother and neater the more you practice it!

quests.instruction: You keep refreshing the screen waiting for the game update to finish. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Watching a loading bar and wishing it would move faster feels very restless.
quests.explanation: Watching a loading bar and wishing it would move faster gives you a restless, waiting feeling.
quests.funFact: Stepping away for a few minutes often makes a wait feel like it passes much faster!

quests.instruction: You finally reach the shore after swimming further than you meant to. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Making it safely back after a moment of worry can make your whole body feel lighter.
quests.explanation: Making it safely back after a moment of worry makes your whole body feel lighter and calmer.
quests.funFact: Swimming parallel to the shore, rather than straight back, is a safe way to return to land.

quests.instruction: You watch a caterpillar's cocoon crack open to reveal a butterfly. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Watching a huge transformation happen right in front of you can leave you staring in wonder.
quests.explanation: Watching a huge transformation happen right in front of you can leave you with an astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: Inside a cocoon, a caterpillar's body almost completely rebuilds itself into a butterfly!

quests.instruction: You write an encouraging note for a friend before their big game. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Taking time to cheer someone on before something important feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Taking time to cheer someone on before something important gives you a warm, kind feeling.
quests.funFact: A short encouraging note can give someone a real boost of confidence before a big moment!

quests.instruction: You decide you will learn to swim across the whole pool by the end of summer. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Setting a clear goal for yourself and sticking to it feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Setting a clear goal for yourself and sticking to it gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: Setting a goal with a clear finish line, like the end of summer, can help you stay focused!

quests.instruction: You keep asking 'are we there yet?' on the long car ride. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Wanting something to happen faster than it is happening can make you fidget in your seat.
quests.explanation: Wanting something to happen faster than it is happening can give you a restless, waiting feeling.
quests.funFact: Playing a simple road game like counting colors can help a long wait feel shorter!

quests.instruction: You finish your big test and realize it was not as hard as you feared. How do you feel?
quests.question: Relieved
quests.hint: Discovering something you dreaded was not so bad after all can make your shoulders drop.
quests.explanation: Discovering something you dreaded was not so bad after all makes your whole body feel lighter.
quests.funFact: This lighter feeling is your body's way of letting go of worry it no longer needs!

quests.instruction: You watch a street performer balance high above the ground on a tightrope. How do you feel?
quests.question: Amazed
quests.hint: Watching someone do something that looks almost impossible can leave you staring in wonder.
quests.explanation: Watching someone do something that looks almost impossible can leave you with an astonished feeling.
quests.funFact: Tightrope walkers practice their balance for years before performing high above a crowd!

quests.instruction: You comfort your little brother after he scrapes his knee. How do you feel?
quests.question: Caring
quests.hint: Helping someone feel better after they get hurt feels warm and kind.
quests.explanation: Helping someone feel better after they get hurt gives you a warm, kind feeling inside.
quests.funFact: A calm, comforting voice can actually help someone feel less pain after a small injury!

quests.instruction: You keep trying new strategies until you finally beat the tricky level. How do you feel?
quests.question: Determined
quests.hint: Refusing to quit and trying new ideas until something works feels strong and focused.
quests.explanation: Refusing to quit and trying new ideas until something works gives you a strong, focused feeling.
quests.funFact: Trying a new strategy instead of repeating the same one is a smart way to solve tricky problems!

quests.instruction: You tap your foot while waiting for the microwave to beep. How do you feel?
quests.question: Impatient
quests.hint: Watching a countdown and wishing it would go faster can make you tap or fidget.
quests.explanation: Watching a countdown and wishing it would go faster can give you a restless, waiting feeling.
quests.funFact: Even a few seconds of waiting can feel much longer when you are excited about what is coming!
